description: #120 stretch 3 attempt 1 (probe; may fail by design: only its metrics matter): boots from touch-md1-2 (kept by touch-s2-md1-2) and plays the generated segment touch-3-s3r-gw0 (runner/test/unit/playthrough-scenarios.js). The end check is field mode. Metrics: out_g, path, locked, scenes, smode, remain, map_cur, field. Only those numbers leave.
